newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares flat, wait-and-see mood prevails.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares flat, wait-and-see mood prevails.

text.p: Slovenian shares ended flat on Monday on low turnover as the market remained in a state of limbo ahead of the introduction of trading accounts for foreign investors.
"Banks should introduce first custodian account schemes later this week. Until then, shares may decline slightly while volumes will remain low," one broker said.
Four weeks ago the Bank of Slovenia said international investors would have to open a custodian account at a domestic bank in order to be able to trade in Slovenian securities.
* The blue-chip SBI index firmed 0.51 points to 1,378.2.
* Bank SKB was the most actively traded, closing unchanged at 56,000 tolars on volume of 310 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
